speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. You are presenting with sudden-onset lower back pain radiating down the leg; can you describe exactly where the pain travels and how severe it is on a scale of 1 to 10? Additionally, do you experience any numbness, tingling, or weakness in that leg?

speaker: Patient
text: 26-year-old woman. The patient reports exercising in the gym several hours ago when she suddenly felt a sharp pain in her lower back. She describes the pain as radiating down the side of her leg and into her foot.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Lumbar Herniated Disc (L4-L5 or L5-S1).

While your description of exercise-induced pain radiating to the foot is highly suggestive of a herniated disc, please confirm if you have any loss of bladder or bowel control or numbness in the saddle area, as these would indicate an emergency.
